calibration_contract.unit_definition: A group of poultry establishments linked by common ownership, pooled across all included years and all fourteen drugs

exchangeable_unit_definition: A group of poultry establishments linked by common ownership, pooled across all included years and all fourteen drugs
coverage_statement: Marginal coverage of the recorded tail intervals simultaneously over the declared panel cuts, not the whole distribution for every eligible cohort of a new exchangeable unit, conditional on the fixed training/reference protocol. Requires exchangeable calibration and target units, the same summary/selection rule and max aggregation. No latent-MIC or conditional-on-covariates guarantee. Panel radii equal the normalized calibration radius times their fixed training scales.
